sources.entry: Meelo - Personal Music Server, designed for collectors and music maniacs. GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Meelo is a self-hosted music server for music collectors, distributed as Docker images, with a mobile app for Android and iOS.
summary.what_it_does: Meelo is a self-hosted music server that the README compares to Plex, Jellyfin, Koel and Black Candy, with a focus on flexible browsing and listening. It provides basic player and server features such as playback, browsing, search, playlists and libraries. Its distinguishing features are handling of music videos, B-sides and rare tracks, automatic featuring and duet detection, and albums with multiple releases and songs with multiple tracks and versions. Metadata can come from embedded tags, file names, or both, and from providers such as MusicBrainz, Genius and Wikipedia. It can push scrobbles to ListenBrainz and LastFM and download or read synced lyrics. Transcoding is used only when a file format is not supported in the browser.
use_cases: stream my music collection from my own server
organize music videos and B-sides alongside albums
scrobble listening history to ListenBrainz or LastFM
listen to music on Android or iOS from a home server
how_to_run: Install Docker (Meelo is shipped as Docker images)
Follow the setup guide in the project wiki
Tag your music with correct embedded metadata before starting
Optionally use file paths with Regexes as metadata sources
notable: Music videos treated as first-class items, separated from interviews and trailers
Identifies B-sides and rare tracks and shows them on album and artist pages
Albums have releases and songs have tracks and versions, with duplicates hidden when browsing
Flexible metadata parsing from embedded tags and file names, including album covers
caveats: Requires some setup; the README says it needs a little bit of setup and points to the wiki
Intended for private use only and not designed for heavy traffic, according to the disclaimer
Public live demo is still in progress per the README
keywords: play my mp3 collection on any device
